title: teline candicans var. umbellata
intro: Teline candicans var. umbellata, commonly known as Fern-leaf Broom or Broom, is a flowering plant in the legume family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Teline candicans var. umbellata include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation.
